canonical_title: Aerial refueling electronic hardware, software, and firmware

versions.title_at_revision: Aerial refueling electronic hardware, software, and firmware
versions.text:
Standard: Electronic hardware, software, and firmware used to perform AR operations which support an SCF are identified and documented as safety-critical. Control actions and movements of an AR system, and monitoring of loads, pressures, states, and positions of AR components are examples of safety-critical functionality. Note: All air system SCFs are first identified by Section 4 criteria. This standard provides the means to identify the SCF subset specific to AR operations. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Examination of development documentation verifies that electronic hardware, software, and firmware used to perform AR operations which support an SCF are identified as safety-critical. Analysis.
  (1) SCFTA identifies all electronic hardware, software, and firmware items that support AR related SCFs.
